description: Validates that an activity using impulses sends correct tracking data

impulsesLoaded.description: Array of impulse IDs that were loaded for this task

impulsesCreated.description: Array of newly created impulse IDs (may be empty)

contextRatio.description: Ratio of impulse tokens to total input tokens (100/200 = 0.5)

tokens.description: Token breakdown with input, output, and cache fields

validationRules: impulsesLoaded must be a non-empty array when impulses are used
impulsesCreated must be an array (may be empty)
contextRatio must be a number between 0 and 1
tokens must be an object with input, output, and cache fields
